mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_notify_message (template_id, title, content, type, level, link_url, receiver_type, receiver_count, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{templateId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{level}, #{linkUrl}, #{receiverType}, #{receiverCount}, #{createBy}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE m FROM sys_notify_message m WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_notify_user_message u WHERE u.message_id = m.id )
